build_vgg_backbone: build a VGG backbone model with depth 16 and batch normalization for feature extraction
create_conv3x3_layer: create a 3x3 convolution layer with configurable input output planes and dilation rate
create_vgg_layer: create a VGG layer with convolutions batch norm relu and max pooling blocks
init_vgg_weights: initialize VGG model weights from a pretrained checkpoint or with kaiming normal init
run_vgg_forward: run forward pass through VGG backbone to extract multi-stage feature maps from input tensor
